smartypants/qwen3.5-9b.architecture: hybrid Gated DeltaNet / gated-attention transformer with dense FFN layers and a vision encoder (32 layers)
smartypants/qwen3.5-9b.strengths: Multimodal (text, image, video input) chat model for reasoning, coding, agent and visual-understanding tasks, with coverage of 201 languages and dialects. Runs in thinking mode by default; thinking can be turned off for direct answers.
smartypants/qwen3.5-9b.uniqueFact: Three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet linear attention instead of full attention (layout 8 x (3 x Gated DeltaNet + 1 x Gated Attention)), and the model is trained with multi-token prediction for speculative decoding.

smartypants/qwen3.5-4b.architecture: hybrid Gated DeltaNet / gated-attention transformer with dense FFN layers and a vision encoder (32 layers)
smartypants/qwen3.5-4b.strengths: Multimodal (text, image, video input) chat model for reasoning, coding, agent and visual-understanding tasks, with coverage of 201 languages and dialects. Runs in thinking mode by default; thinking can be turned off for direct answers.
smartypants/qwen3.5-4b.uniqueFact: Same 32-layer hybrid layout as Qwen3.5-9B but with a 2,560-wide hidden dimension and an output layer tied to the token embedding, which keeps it at 4B parameters while supporting 201 languages and dialects.

smartypants/qwen3.8-27b.architecture: dense hybrid Gated DeltaNet / gated-attention transformer with a vision encoder (64 layers)
smartypants/qwen3.8-27b.strengths: Dense vision-language model aimed at coding, professional work, research and long-horizon agentic tasks, with native image and video understanding (including hour-scale videos).
smartypants/qwen3.8-27b.uniqueFact: Thinking is on by default but can be disabled per request, reasoning depth can be tuned with a reasoning_effort setting, and preserve_thinking keeps reasoning from earlier turns in context.

smartypants/nanbeige4.3-33b.strengths: Text-only English/Chinese model built for agentic coding and professional 'cowork' tasks such as multi-turn tool use and office workflows, with switchable thinking and non-thinking modes.
smartypants/nanbeige4.3-33b.uniqueFact: Nanbeige4.3-33B is the flagship 'teacher' model of the Nanbeige4.3 series: its developers built it first so they can distil its agent skills into smaller models such as a planned Nanbeige4.3-3B.

smartypants/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.architecture: mixture-of-experts hybrid Gated DeltaNet / gated-attention transformer with a vision encoder (40 layers, 256 experts)
smartypants/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.strengths: First open-weight Qwen3.6 model, focused on agentic coding (frontend work and repository-level reasoning) and stability in real use; accepts image input alongside text.
smartypants/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.uniqueFact: Each token is routed to 8 of 256 experts plus 1 shared expert, so only about 3B of its 35B parameters are active per token; it also added an option to keep reasoning from earlier messages (thinking preservation).

smartypants/gpt-oss-20b.architecture: mixture-of-experts decoder-only transformer (24 layers, 32 experts, 4 active per token)
smartypants/gpt-oss-20b.strengths: Smaller of OpenAI's two open-weight gpt-oss models, meant for lower-latency, local or specialised use: reasoning, agentic tasks, function calling, web browsing, Python code execution and structured outputs.
smartypants/gpt-oss-20b.uniqueFact: Reasoning effort is adjustable (low, medium, high), and the MoE weights were post-trained in MXFP4 so the model runs within 16 GB of memory; it must be used with OpenAI's harmony response format.

smartypants/qwen3-embedding-0.6b.architecture: text embedding model built on the dense Qwen3-0.6B base (28 layers)
smartypants/qwen3-embedding-0.6b.strengths: Turns text into vectors for retrieval, semantic search, classification and clustering, including cross-lingual and code retrieval across 100+ languages; accepts task-specific instructions.
smartypants/qwen3-embedding-0.6b.uniqueFact: Outputs embeddings of up to 1,024 dimensions and supports Matryoshka-style (MRL) custom output sizes anywhere from 32 to 1,024 dimensions.

smartypants/whisper-large-v3-turbo.nativeContext: 30-second audio window (longer audio is transcribed in 30-second chunks)
smartypants/whisper-large-v3-turbo.strengths: Automatic speech recognition and speech translation into English, trained on more than 5 million hours of labelled audio.
smartypants/whisper-large-v3-turbo.uniqueFact: It is a fine-tuned, pruned Whisper large-v3 with the decoder cut from 32 layers to 4, which makes it much faster at the cost of a small drop in quality.

smartypants/flux.1-schnell.strengths: Generates images from text prompts; licensed for personal, scientific and commercial use.
smartypants/flux.1-schnell.uniqueFact: Trained with latent adversarial diffusion distillation, it can produce an image in 1 to 4 sampling steps (the reference example uses 4 steps with guidance scale 0).
